% Standalone force-rose figure (R2.7 companion to Fig. 14).

% Use a PDF viewer with auto-refresh (e.g., Skim) for live preview.
\documentclass[border=5pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta, calc}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\graphicspath{{./}}

% Macro used in labels (self-contained, no dependency on main paper)
\newcommand{\Kzero}{K_0}

% Auto-generated A_c, B_c, A_n, B_n values; regenerate via:
%   uv run anisotropy_values.py
\input{anisotropy_values}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \def\imgW{3.4cm}
  \def\gap{1pt}
  \def\rowgap{12pt}

  % --- Row 1: K0=0.5 ---
  \node[anchor=north west, inner sep=0] (a1) at (0,0)
    {\includegraphics[width=\imgW]{contact_force_k0_05_t0.png}};
  \node[font=\small, anchor=south] at (a1.north) {$N/N_L = 0.00$};
  \node[anchor=north west, inner sep=0] (a2) at ([xshift=\gap]a1.north east)
    {\includegraphics[width=\imgW]{contact_force_k0_05_t302.png}};
  \node[font=\small, anchor=south] at (a2.north) {$N/N_L \approx 0.61$};
  \node[anchor=north west, inner sep=0] (a3) at ([xshift=\gap]a2.north east)
    {\includegraphics[width=\imgW]{contact_force_k0_05_t523.png}};
  \node[font=\small, anchor=south] at (a3.north) {$N/N_L \approx 1.05$};
  \node[anchor=north west, inner sep=0] (a4) at ([xshift=\gap]a3.north east)
    {\includegraphics[width=\imgW]{contact_force_k0_05_t529.png}};
  \node[font=\small, anchor=south] at (a4.north) {$N/N_L \approx 1.07$};

  % --- Axis labels on first image (a1) ---
  \coordinate (axO) at ([xshift=6pt, yshift=12pt]a1.south west);
  \draw[->, thick] (axO) -- ++(0, 14pt)   node[font=\scriptsize, right, inner sep=1pt] {$z$};
  \draw[->, thick] (axO) -- ++(16pt, 2pt) node[font=\scriptsize, right, inner sep=1pt] {$\theta$};
  \draw[->, thick] (axO) -- ++(8pt, -8pt) node[font=\scriptsize, right, inner sep=1pt] {$r$};

  % --- Anisotropy annotations (bottom-right of each panel) ---
  % A_n, B_n are the principal-axis magnitude and tilt of the
  % normal-force-weighted contact fabric tensor in local cylindrical
  % (theta, r, z) frame:
  %   A_n = sqrt(3/2) || F_n - I/3 ||_F   with F_n weighted by |F_n^c|
  %   B_n = angle of principal eigenvector from axial direction z, in [0, 90 deg]
  \node[font=\tiny, anchor=south east, align=right, inner sep=2pt] at (a1.south east)
    {$A_n = \Anai$\\$B_n = \Bnai^\circ$\\$\langle F_n\rangle = \Fbarai$\,N};
  \node[font=\tiny, anchor=south east, align=right, inner sep=2pt] at (a2.south east)
    {$A_n = \Anaii$\\$B_n = \Bnaii^\circ$\\$\langle F_n\rangle = \Fbaraii$\,N};
  \node[font=\tiny, anchor=south east, align=right, inner sep=2pt] at (a3.south east)
    {$A_n = \Anaiii$\\$B_n = \Bnaiii^\circ$\\$\langle F_n\rangle = \Fbaraiii$\,N};
  \node[font=\tiny, anchor=south east, align=right, inner sep=2pt] at (a4.south east)
    {$A_n = \Anaiv$\\$B_n = \Bnaiv^\circ$\\$\langle F_n\rangle = \Fbaraiv$\,N};

  % K0=0.5 label
  \path (a1.south) -- (a4.south) coordinate[midway] (row1mid);
  \node[font=\scriptsize, anchor=north] at ([yshift=-1pt]row1mid) {$\Kzero{} = 0.5$};

  % --- Row 2: K0=2.0 ---
  \node[anchor=north west, inner sep=0] (b1) at ([yshift=-\rowgap]a1.south west)
    {\includegraphics[width=\imgW]{contact_force_k0_20_t0.png}};
  \node[anchor=north west, inner sep=0] (b2) at ([xshift=\gap]b1.north east)
    {\includegraphics[width=\imgW]{contact_force_k0_20_t226.png}};
  \node[anchor=north west, inner sep=0] (b3) at ([xshift=\gap]b2.north east)
    {\includegraphics[width=\imgW]{contact_force_k0_20_t379.png}};
  \node[anchor=north west, inner sep=0] (b4) at ([xshift=\gap]b3.north east)
    {\includegraphics[width=\imgW]{contact_force_k0_20_t386.png}};

  % --- Anisotropy annotations (bottom-right of each panel) ---
  \node[font=\tiny, anchor=south east, align=right, inner sep=2pt] at (b1.south east)
    {$A_n = \Anbi$\\$B_n = \Bnbi^\circ$\\$\langle F_n\rangle = \Fbarbi$\,N};
  \node[font=\tiny, anchor=south east, align=right, inner sep=2pt] at (b2.south east)
    {$A_n = \Anbii$\\$B_n = \Bnbii^\circ$\\$\langle F_n\rangle = \Fbarbii$\,N};
  \node[font=\tiny, anchor=south east, align=right, inner sep=2pt] at (b3.south east)
    {$A_n = \Anbiii$\\$B_n = \Bnbiii^\circ$\\$\langle F_n\rangle = \Fbarbiii$\,N};
  \node[font=\tiny, anchor=south east, align=right, inner sep=2pt] at (b4.south east)
    {$A_n = \Anbiv$\\$B_n = \Bnbiv^\circ$\\$\langle F_n\rangle = \Fbarbiv$\,N};

  % K0=2.0 label
  \path (b1.south) -- (b4.south) coordinate[midway] (row2mid);
  \node[font=\scriptsize, anchor=north] at ([yshift=-1pt]row2mid) {$\Kzero{} = 2.0$};

  % --- Rainbow colorbar (right, spanning both rows) ---
  % DENSITY_MAX_FORCE = 1.2 N in the Blender renderer;
  % colorbar ticks span 0 .. 1.2 N (mean |F_n| per contact in each bin).
  \pgfpointdiff{\pgfpointanchor{b4}{south}}{\pgfpointanchor{a4}{north}}
  \pgfgetlastxy{\discard}{\cbarH}
  \node[anchor=north west, inner sep=0] (cbar) at ([xshift=4pt]a4.north east)
    {\includegraphics[height=\cbarH]{colorbar_rainbow.png}};
  \foreach \val/\frac in {1.2/0, 0.9/0.25, 0.6/0.5, 0.3/0.75, 0/1.0} {
    \node[font=\footnotesize, anchor=west] at
      ([xshift=2pt, yshift={-\frac*\cbarH}]cbar.north east) {\val};
  }
  \node[font=\footnotesize, rotate=90, anchor=south] at
    ([xshift=32pt]cbar.east) {Mean normal contact force $\overline{F}_n$ (N)};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
